name: NY-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Grace Meng running in a D+6 district with a large fundraising edge
Republican challenger Joseph Chou has raised only about $2,600
Prediction markets price Meng near certain to win
model.rationale: Meng is a well-funded incumbent in a Democratic-leaning district, while Chou's campaign has essentially no money, and markets price her win probability near 98%. The fundamentals-based margin of roughly 20 points fits comfortably.
model.watch: A major outside-spending intervention for Chou or an unexpected Meng scandal would be the main ways this race could tighten.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Grace Meng seeks another term in this Queens-based district that leans Democratic by about six points. She has raised over $2 million and holds more than $1 million on hand, while Republican Joseph Chou has raised only a few thousand dollars and has no meaningful outside support. No public polling of the race exists, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive.

Prediction markets put Meng's chances near 98 percent, consistent with the fundamentals. With an incumbent advantage, a dominant financial position, and a low-profile challenger, the race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty coming from the absence of polling rather than any sign of a genuine contest.
